name: opencode-team
description: Let OpenCode or ZCode workers on your own model (Qwen, DeepSeek, GLM, Ollama…) join your Claude Code team: spawn them with the Agent tool, talk to them with SendMessage, and let Claude approve their shell commands as project manager.

backend.title: Worker agent
backend.description: Which coding agent runs the workers: opencode (an `opencode serve` server) or zcode (headless ZCode runs).

model.title: Worker model (required)
model.description: The only model workers run on. OpenCode: provider/model, e.g. company/qwen3.8. ZCode: providerId/modelId from ~/.zcode/v2/provider_config.json, e.g. qwen/qwen3-coder-plus.

workerPermissions.title: Worker permissions
workerPermissions.description: lead: workers edit freely and Claude approves or rejects each shell command (no dialogs for you). ask: you approve each shell command in a dialog. read-only: no edits, no shell. full-auto: edits and shell without asking.

serverUrl.title: OpenCode server URL
serverUrl.description: Where `opencode serve` listens. The mod starts it here if nothing answers and auto-start is on.

autoStart.title: Start OpenCode automatically
autoStart.description: Start `opencode serve` in the project folder when the server isn't running.

opencodeCommand.title: OpenCode command
opencodeCommand.description: The command that runs OpenCode, if `opencode` isn't on your PATH.

agent.title: OpenCode agent
agent.description: The OpenCode agent workers run as. build is OpenCode's own coding agent; it keeps plugins that swap the default agent from changing the model.

zcodeCommand.title: ZCode command
zcodeCommand.description: The ZCode CLI. Default: the copy inside the ZCode desktop app on Windows (…\Programs\ZCodeesources\glm\zcode.cjs), else `zcode` on PATH.

serverPassword.title: OpenCode server password
serverPassword.description: Only if you set OPENCODE_SERVER_PASSWORD for `opencode serve`.

pollSeconds.title: Poll interval (seconds)
pollSeconds.description: How often to check workers for replies and messages.
